verdict.rationale: Paychex documents a REST API with OAuth 2.0 and check-creation use cases, but nothing shows an API endpoint for previewing a payroll run or returning anomalies. 'Intelligent Pay Cycle flags issues' is an in-product feature with no documented API exposure, and Pre-check is employee-facing paycheck review, not an agent-driven preview. Both are adjacent features, so they earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent run a payroll preview via the API and surface anomalies for review before I approve the run
